patch_description:
This replaces sequential strict coordinate hill-climbing with a deterministic island-based differential-evolution search. The prior programs showed that multiple starting geometries are valuable, but their coordinate updates could not cross valleys where a temporary decrease in the smallest triangle is needed. The new approach evolves complete 13-point configurations simultaneously, using several structured and randomized populations, periodic migration, lower-tail selection early in the run, and strict minimum-area selection late in the run.

The square corners remain fixed, giving an exactly unit-area convex hull. Full-population vectorized triangle evaluation makes global exploration substantially cheaper than repeatedly constructing proposal arrays for one coordinate at a time. A final deterministic directional polish recovers local max-min improvements from the best evolved configuration.
